status_effects.explanation: The narrator's portrait of Odette as unprincipled and sournoise ('sly') in her habitual lying casts a mildly negative light on her character, independent of the exclusion dynamic already scored for Swann.

appraisal_events.evidence: "Odette n'en possédait pas [un système général du mensonge]; elle se contentait seulement... de ne pas le lui dire"; "toujours la même volonté fugace, insaisissable et sournoise"
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator characterizes Odette as lacking any coherent principle behind her lying, acting only from case-by-case, sly expedience rather than reflection, a mildly diminishing psychological portrait.
